LanguageData.HH.Ins.Slogan.1: Clawback Mutual. We've got you covered.* (*see clauses 1 to infinity)
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Slogan.4: We're there when you need us. Office hours apply.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Slogan.5: Every limb has a price. We wrote it down.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Slogan.6: Your claim is important to us. Please hold.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Slogan.7: Comprehensive cover, comprehensively explained in 400 pages.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Slogan.8: Most colonies choose Premium. Most colonies are still waiting.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Sign.Off: Clawback Mutual is not open for business in this game.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Sign.Duplicate: You already hold this policy. We checked twice.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Sign.Debt: No new policies until you have settled the {0} we are owed from clause 22.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Sign.NoMap: We could not find your colony. This is unusual.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Sign.Threat: Clawback Mutual does not sign cover while a threat, a raid or a large fire is on. We would hate to be unfair to ourselves.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Sign.CannotPay: The first instalment of {0} could not be debited. Even we cannot insure an empty purse.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Locked.Actuarial: Needs the research project Actuarial Science
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Log.Regrowth: Claim #{0}: a part grew back, {1} claimed back.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.End.Holder: the insured person is no longer with us
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Clause.Exclusion: This is an exclusion, not a decision. We merely read it out.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Bd.PreExisting: Deducted: {0} % that was there when you signed (clause 9).
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Bd.PartialNotPaid: Partial losses are not paid at Bare Minimum.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Bd.BelowThreshold: The grade is below the threshold of {0} % for your tier. Benefit: 0 silver. Congratulations.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Bd.Progression: {0}: progression gives {1} of the basic sum of {2}. Benefit before the fine print: {3}.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Bd.Contributed: An old ailment on the same part cuts the benefit by 25 % (clause 9, from Overbooked).
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Bd.DeathAssess: Claim #{0} ended with the death (clause 23): the higher of both is paid.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Bd.UnderInsured: Under-insured: sum {0} against a value of {1}. We pay {2} of it, proudly.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Bd.Kulanz: Goodwill gesture (once a year, Premium only). Do not get used to it.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Bd.Legal: Legal Shield made us less enthusiastic about denying this.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Welcome.Title: Welcome to Clawback Mutual: {0}
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Welcome.Body:
Dear policyholder,
thank you for choosing {0} at {1}. Your premium of {2} will be debited automatically every {3} days. You need to do nothing, ever, which is the idea.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Welcome.Waiting: Cover begins after a waiting period of {0} days. The waiting period begins when cover begins. Please see clause 1.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Welcome.Riders: To save you time, these add-ons were included for you: {0}. You can remove them in the desk whenever you like, in principle.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Welcome.Paid: The first instalment was debited from {0}.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Filed.Title: Claim #{0} received
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Filed.Body: We have received your claim #{0} ({1}) under {2}. It is important to us. Our Claims Department will look at it in one to three days, depending on how it looks back.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Filed.Death: We are sorry for your loss. Claim ({0}) has been received and will be handled with care.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Filed.Assessment: Accident cover is assessed {0} after the accident, when the damage has settled. Preview of the benefit today: {1}.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Filed.Waiting: Please note that the event happened during the waiting period. We say this kindly.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.Approved: Good news. Your claim is approved: {0}.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.Partial: Your claim is partly approved: {0} of {1}. We are very proud of the part we approved.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.Denied: After careful consideration, which took some time, your claim is denied.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.CanNegotiate: You may negotiate within ten days; our door is open, in a manner of speaking.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.PayLater: Payment follows in {0}. Processing times are not a promise, they are a hope.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.InKind: You may also take building materials by capsule instead of silver (open the desk).
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Paid.Title: Claim #{0}: paid
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Paid.Body: Claim #{0} has been paid: {1}, {2}. Thank you for being a customer. We will remember it at your next premium.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Paid.Neutral: The benefit of {0} has been paid, {1}. We wish you strength.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Ended.Title: {0}: ended
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Ended.Debt: A claw-back of {0} (clause 22) remains open. New policies need it settled first.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Missed.Title: {0}: premium not received
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Missed.Body: We could not debit {1} for {0}. A friendly reminder: we will try again tomorrow, and the day after. Then we will stop being friendly.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Lapsed.Title: {0}: lapsed
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Lapsed.Body: Your policy {0} has lapsed after three missed instalments ({1} each). Your cover ended, which is a sad thing for us to write and an efficient thing to bill.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Premium.Title: {0}: premium adjusted
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Premium.Body: Your premium for {0} was adjusted from {1} to {2} per quadrum to reflect your circumstances. For five days you may cancel it at once, which we mention because the law makes us.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Regrowth.Title: {0}: a part grew back
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Regrowth.Body: We were pleased to learn that a part of {0} has grown back. We claim back {1}. {2} {3}
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Regrowth.Offset: It will be offset against future benefits.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Regrowth.Debt: It is open as a debt; no new policies until it is settled.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Renew.Title: {0}: renewal notice
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Renew.Body: Your policy {0} renews in three days. {1}
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Retro.Title: Bundle discount recalculated
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Retro.Body: Because you left, the bundle discount of the running quadrum was recalculated. We debited {0}. It is on the last page.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Uncovered.Title: You could have been covered.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Uncovered.Body: We noticed the loss of {0}. It was not insured. {1} would have been happy to help. It still is, for a premium.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Year.Title: Your Clawback year
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Year.Intro: A year with Clawback Mutual: {0} in premiums over {1} active policies. Here is what our sales tricks cost you.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Year.Total: Together: {0}, which is {1} of your yearly premiums (cap: {2}).
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Year.Credit: Courtesy credit: {0} paid back to you, {1}.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Letter.Year.NoCredit: Everything is within the cap. We call that fair.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Upsell.Title: Clawback Mutual suggests
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Upsell.Body: Your {0} at {1} is lovely. Most colonies choose Premium.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Neg.Title: Negotiating claim #{0}
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Neg.Lead: {0}. Offer now: {1} (claim value {2}). Up to three rounds. Choose the tone.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Neg.NoNegotiator: Nobody in the colony can talk right now.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Neg.Approach.Quote: Quote the contract back at them
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Neg.HintQuote: Works best against a clause that is open to interpretation. Hopeless against an exclusion.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Neg.HintLawyers: Legal Shield is on your side. Brix & Partners adore a dispute.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Neg.HintNoLawyers: You have no Legal Shield; they will notice.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Neg.Success: They gave in. Possibly a first. The full benefit is yours: {0}.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Neg.Partial: After some sighing they offer {0} ({1} of the benefit). Take it or try again.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Neg.Fail: The Claims Department thanks you for your input and keeps its decision.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Neg.NotPossible: This claim cannot be negotiated any more.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Neg.Cancelled: As you were rude about the clauses, Clawback Mutual has decided to part ways with you. The policy is cancelled.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Neg.Free: On this difficulty, negotiating never costs you anything.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Neg.RiskHard: Harder levels: a third failed round can make them cancel your policy.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Cancel.Title: Cancel policy
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Cancel.When: The cancellation takes effect in about {0} days: at the next quadrum change at least {1} days after you file it.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Cancel.When.Special: Special cancellation: this is effective immediately, because of a settled claim or a premium increase.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Cancel.Bundle: Leaving raises your other premiums by {0}. {1}
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Cancel.Bundle.Future: The bundle discount drops from now on, not backwards.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Cancel.Bundle.Retro: The discount of the running quadrum will be recalculated and charged.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Cancel.FormNote: Cancellations need Form C-7. Occasionally one comes back. {0}
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Cancel.Owed: Open claw-back on this policy: {0}. It will be settled in the final account.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Cancel.Filed: Your cancellation is filed. It will be effective in {0}. We are sorry to see you go and will try to see you again.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Cancel.Special: Special cancellation filed. The policy ends now.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Cancel.FormErrorSoft: Your Form C-7 came back with a form error. We re-filed it for you, so your deadline is safe. You are welcome.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Cancel.FormErrorHard: Your Form C-7 came back with an error (ink colour). The deadline was missed and slips by one quadrum. We have no further comment.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Retention.Title: Before you go
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Retention.Body: We are sad to see {0} go. What if we made it {1} cheaper for {2} quadrums? Honest offer, no strings. (There are some strings. They are quite thin.)
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Retention.Body2: That was a good offer. This one is better: {1} off {0} for {2} quadrums. Please do not think of it as a trap.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Retention.Body3: I have been passed your file. {0} for {1} off, {2} quadrums. I will personally forward your cancellation to a colleague who is on holiday.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Retention.MinTerm: Discount means a new minimum term: you cannot leave until it is over.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Retention.Still: No thanks, I still want to cancel
LanguageData.HH.Ins.Retention.Kept: Welcome back. Your discount is {0} for {1} quadrums.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.NoGame: Clawback Mutual is closed outside a game.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Footer: Insurance is a promise. We keep the part that is in writing.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Bundle.Title: Bundle:
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Bundle.None: Your first policy is the hardest. The third gives 10 % off all of them.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Bundle.Some: {0} active policies, {1} off. The third gives {2}.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Mech.Property: Own share {0}, pays {1} of the value.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Mech.Person: From {0} % invalidity, up to {1} of the sum.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Fine.Tail: The full terms are the 400 pages mentioned in our slogan. See also the Fine print tab.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Mine.None: You have no policy yet. It is the one thing we are sure about.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Mine.Foot: Policies renew automatically (clause 31). Special cancellation: after a settled claim or a premium increase you can leave within five days, immediately.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Debt: You owe Clawback Mutual {0} from clause 22.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Debt.Cannot: You cannot pay that right now.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Claims.None: No claims. Clawback Mutual is delighted and a little suspicious.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Fine.Title: The fine print
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Fine.Lead: Fifteen clauses, as printed. From a certain level of sales pressure they are shown only as references. Clauses in grey are not active on your difficulty.
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Limbs.Title: Schedule of Limbs
LanguageData.HH.Ins.UI.Limbs.Lead: Values in percent of the basic sum, per side. A lost part counts its value and replaces the values of its children; several parts add up to at most 100 %.
